title: AI × Math 每日精选
subtitle: 自动推理、形式化证明、数学智能与基础模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: InSight: A Benchmark for Agentic Claim Verification in Interactive Visualizations
items.abstract_or_text: Vision Language Models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in interpreting static visual artifacts, but modern data analysis is inherently dynamic, requiring the active interrogation of interactive environments. Existing benchmarks are predominantly constrained to static imagery and one-shot question answering and fail to capture the epistemic demands of this domain, where evidence is frequently occluded, distributed across linked views, or conditionally revealed through user agency. In this paper, we introduce InSight, a benchmark for agentic claim verification over interactive visualizations. The dataset consists of 21,349 claims derived from human-authored analytical narratives and grounded in fully interactive web-based environments. Agents must navigate these environments to determine whether a natural language claim is supported, refuted or not verifiable given the available evidence. Unlike traditional evaluations, InSight treats interaction traces as intrinsic proxies for reasoning, enabling a rigorous audit of how models seek and synthesize visual evidence. We evaluate state-of-the-art models, revealing that interactive verification remains a non-trivial challenge. We release InSight at https://github.com/maevehutch/insight.
items.summary_zh: InSight 构建了交互式可视化中的智能体主张核验基准，要求模型通过操作网页环境判断主张是否得到证据支持、被证据反驳或无法核验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据集给出 21,349 条由人工分析叙述导出的主张，并将交互轨迹用于审视取证过程；其评测显示，交互式证据核验对现有模型仍是困难任务。
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在解读静态视觉材料方面已展现出显著能力，但现代数据分析本质上是动态的，需要主动探查交互环境。现有基准主要受限于静态图像和一次性问答，未能反映该领域的认识论要求：证据常被遮挡、分布在相互关联的视图中，或仅在用户主动操作时显现。本文提出 InSight，一个面向交互式可视化的智能体主张核验基准。该数据集包含 21,349 条由人工撰写的分析叙述导出的主张，并以完全交互式的网页环境为依据。智能体必须浏览这些环境，以判断一项自然语言主张是否得到现有证据支持、被证据反驳，或无法核验。不同于传统评测，InSight 将交互轨迹视为推理的内在代理指标，从而能够严格审视模型如何寻找并综合视觉证据。我们评测了最先进模型，结果显示交互式核验仍是一项并不容易的任务。我们在 https://github.com/maevehutch/insight 发布 InSight。
items.author_line: Maeve Hutchinson, Syed Mahbubul Huq, Mohammad Albinhassan, Radu Jianu, Aidan Slingsby, Pranava Madhyastha

items.title: When Decodability Is Not Enough: Logical Validity Representations, Behavioral Dissociation, and Causal Tests in Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models can look capable of logical reasoning, but correct or incorrect answers alone tell us little about what the model represents internally. We study logical verification in five open-weight transformer models using matched valid--invalid premise--claim pairs that vary across inference families, semantic domains, templates, and difficulty levels. Despite near-chance behavioral performance, logical validity is often almost perfectly decodable from hidden states and remains strongly decodable under held-out templates, domains, and inference families. Validity also remains highly decodable on behaviorally incorrect examples in the conditions where correctness-conditioned evaluation is well defined. At the same time, exhaustive leave-one-out tests reveal clear limits to this generalization, and interventions along probe-derived validity directions have only weak, nonspecific effects compared with random controls. Our results suggest that representing validity, expressing it in behavior, and using it causally are distinct. Validity related information can be strongly decodable from a model's hidden states without being reliably expressed in its output.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以五个开放权重 Transformer 为对象，区分逻辑有效性信息在隐藏状态中可被解码、能在行为上表达以及能产生因果作用这三件不同的事。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 匹配的有效—无效前提—主张对、留一检验和干预对照共同表明，仅凭探针可解码性不能证明模型会稳定地运用逻辑有效性。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型可能看起来具有逻辑推理能力，但单凭答案正确或错误，对模型内部表征的了解很少。我们利用在推理家族、语义领域、模板和难度上变化的匹配有效—无效前提—主张对，研究五个开放权重 Transformer 中的逻辑核验。尽管行为表现接近随机猜测，逻辑有效性通常可以从隐藏状态中近乎完美地解码，并且在留出的模板、领域和推理家族上仍具有很强的可解码性。在以正确性为条件的评估定义明确的情形中，即使在行为错误的样本上，有效性也仍然高度可解码。同时，穷尽式留一检验揭示了这种泛化的明确局限；与随机对照相比，沿探针导出的有效性方向进行干预只产生微弱且非特异的影响。我们的结果表明，表征有效性、在行为中表达有效性和因果性地使用有效性彼此不同。与有效性相关的信息可以从模型隐藏状态中被强力解码，却未必能可靠地体现在其输出中。

items.title: Benchmarking Language Models for Statistical Problem Formulation
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as assistants for statistical and data science work, yet existing evaluations largely assume the analysis target is already specified. In practice, users arrive with informal goals and heterogeneous data, leaving the model to decide what statistical task is implied and which data are relevant. We first formalize this upstream step as Statistical Problem Formulation and decompose it into two subtasks: (1) Statistical Problem Classification and (2) Variable Identification & Role Assignment. We then introduce StatFormBench, a benchmark built from five cross-domain statistics textbooks and a data science case library, covering diverse problem types, data representations, and scenario styles. It contains 1,013 samples spanning 20 coarse-grained and 85 fine-grained statistical problem categories. Across 14 open- and closed-source LLMs, the best zero-shot models reach only 72.0 fine-grained classification accuracy and 63.2 variable set overlap. No model performs consistently best across the two subtasks, while enhanced prompting strategies yield only limited or inconsistent gains. We release the benchmark data on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/THU-CongLab/StatFormBench and the evaluation code on GitHub at https://github.com/THU-CongLab/StatFormBench.
items.summary_zh: StatFormBench 将统计问题表述形式化为统计问题分类、变量识别与角色分配两个子任务，并在 1,013 个样本上评测 14 个开放和闭源 LLM。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 基准把统计分析中常被默认已经给定的前置判断转化为可测任务；最佳零样本模型在细粒度分类和变量集合重叠上仍有明显不足。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）日益被用作统计和数据科学工作的助手，但现有评测大多假设分析目标已经给定。在实际中，用户带来的是非正式目标和异质数据，模型需要决定其中隐含了什么统计任务以及哪些数据相关。我们首先将这一步形式化为 Statistical Problem Formulation，并将其拆分为两个子任务：（1）Statistical Problem Classification；（2）Variable Identification & Role Assignment。随后，我们提出 StatFormBench，一个由五本跨领域统计教材和一个数据科学案例库构建的基准，覆盖多样的问题类型、数据表示和场景风格。它包含 1,013 个样本，涵盖 20 个粗粒度和 85 个细粒度统计问题类别。在 14 个开放和闭源 LLM 上，表现最好的零样本模型细粒度分类准确率仅为 72.0，变量集合重叠仅为 63.2。没有模型能在两个子任务上始终表现最佳，而增强提示策略只带来有限或不一致的提升。我们在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/THU-CongLab/StatFormBench 发布基准数据，并在 https://github.com/THU-CongLab/StatFormBench 发布评测代码。
items.author_line: Chen Wang, Junzhe Zhao, Xin Cong, Wanlu Deng, Ke Deng

items.title: Skill Following: Evaluating Actual Skill Use in Retrieval-Enabled LLM Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external skills, yet standard evaluations obscure whether retrieving these skills actually helps. Aggregate metrics often compare retrieved versus non-retrieved tasks, introducing severe selection bias and failing to isolate the true effect of skill use. To measure this actual-use capability-which we formalize as Skill Following (SF)-we introduce the Retrieval-Invoked Actual-Use Effect (RAE). RAE computes the same-task outcome difference between matched skill-enabled and skill-disabled executions, conditioned exclusively on tasks where the agent actively retrieved a skill. Evaluating 17 LLMs across coding and mathematical domains, we uncover a stark evaluation paradox: models frequently show positive aggregate retrieval lift but negative RAE. On MBPP+, multiple models that appear to benefit system-wide actually harm their own performance on the exact tasks where retrieval occurred. These findings demonstrate that aggregate averages can create a misleading illusion of tool-use proficiency, whereas RAE directly measures whether the retrieval-to-answer pipeline genuinely rescues more outcomes than it harms.
items.summary_zh: Skill Following 提出 Retrieval-Invoked Actual-Use Effect（RAE），以智能体确实检索到技能的同一任务配对执行结果衡量技能是否带来帮助。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该指标避免将检索与未检索任务直接比较产生的选择偏差；在编程和数学任务中，聚合收益为正并不代表检索发生时模型表现会改善。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益依赖外部技能，但标准评测掩盖了检索这些技能是否确有帮助。聚合指标通常比较检索到技能和未检索到技能的任务，因此引入严重的选择偏差，无法分离技能使用的真实效应。为衡量这种实际使用能力——我们将其形式化为 Skill Following（SF）——我们提出 Retrieval-Invoked Actual-Use Effect（RAE）。RAE 在智能体主动检索技能的任务上，以技能启用和技能禁用执行之间的同一任务结果差异进行计算。对编程和数学领域的 17 个 LLM 评测后，我们发现一个明显的评测悖论：模型常表现出正向的聚合检索增益，却有负的 RAE。在 MBPP+ 上，一些看似在系统整体上受益的模型，实际上会在恰好发生检索的任务上损害自身表现。这些发现表明，聚合平均数可能制造工具使用能力的误导性印象，而 RAE 直接衡量检索到回答的流程是否真正改善的结果多于其损害的结果。

items.title: DocHop: Benchmarking Out-of-domain Multi-hop Reasoning in Information-Dense Documents
items.abstract_or_text: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on structured visual understanding tasks such as chart and document question answering. However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate these domains in isolation, leaving underexplored a key capability: whether models can use textual context to determine how chart evidence should be selected, interpreted, and aggregated. We introduce DocHop, a benchmark for integrated chart--context reasoning in document-style images. In DocHop, the document narrative specifies multi-step compositional constraints, while charts provide the corresponding data values. Questions are grounded on a semantic reference label defined in the narrative, requiring models to resolve target entities from context before aggregating evidence across multiple charts. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct DocHop via a stochastic logic-first generation pipeline with controllable reasoning depth and visual density, covering 2,074 examples across six task categories. Experiments on a wide range of proprietary and open-source MLLMs show a substantial gap to human performance: annotators achieve over 90% accuracy, while the best model reaches only 62.83%. Reasoning-enhanced models consistently show improved results, but performance degrades as reasoning complexity increases. Overall, DocHop provides a controlled testbed for challenging multi-hop document reasoning.
items.summary_zh: DocHop 是将文档叙述中的组合约束与图表数值证据结合起来的多跳推理基准，提供可控推理深度和视觉密度的 2,074 个样本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 人类标注者准确率超过 90%，最佳模型仅达 62.83%；随着推理复杂度增加而下降的表现，为多模态数学式信息整合提供了清晰的测量对象。
items.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在图表和文档问答等结构化视觉理解任务上已取得强劲表现。然而，现有基准通常孤立地评估这些领域，因而较少考察一项关键能力：模型能否利用文本语境决定应如何选择、解释和汇总图表证据。我们提出 DocHop，一个用于文档风格图像中图表—语境整合推理的基准。在 DocHop 中，文档叙述规定多步组合约束，而图表提供相应的数据值。问题以叙述中定义的语义参照标签为基础，要求模型先从语境中确定目标实体，再汇总多幅图表中的证据。为实现系统评测，我们通过随机、逻辑优先的生成流程构建 DocHop，其推理深度和视觉密度可控，包含六类任务的 2,074 个样本。对大量专有和开源 MLLM 的实验显示，它们与人类表现存在明显差距：标注者准确率超过 90%，最佳模型仅为 62.83%。推理增强模型的表现持续更好，但随着推理复杂度增加，性能会下降。总体而言，DocHop 为具有挑战性的多跳文档推理提供了一个可控测试平台。
items.author_line: Zhuoran Yu, Le Thien Phuc Nguyen, Jaden Park, Xinyi Gu, Zexue He, Soochahn Lee, Rogerio Feris, Yong Jae Lee

items.title: GeoPAR: Large-Scale Multi-Agent Combinatorial Optimization with Geometry-Guided Parallel Autoregressive Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Multi-agent combinatorial optimization problems are notoriously challenging due to their NP-hard nature. Recent parallel autoregressive neural solvers improve inference efficiency by allowing agents to make decisions simultaneously, but their performance often degrades on large-scale instances. This is largely attributable to weak modeling of local geometric structures and the fact that conflicting task selections are handled only after action generation. To address these limitations, we propose GeoPAR, a geometry-guided parallel autoregressive reinforcement learning framework for scalable multi-agent combinatorial optimization. GeoPAR integrates three key components: (1) a projection-window sparse geometry mechanism that builds lightweight local candidate neighborhoods through multi-directional projections, (2) sparse edge-biased attention that injects these geometric relations into node representations, and (3) cache-guided conflict-aware assignment that reuses the geometric cache during decoding to suppress duplicate selections of exclusive tasks. Experiments on heterogeneous vehicle routing and open multi-depot pickup-and-delivery problems show that GeoPAR improves large-scale zero-shot generalization while substantially reducing rollout steps and maintaining efficient inference.
items.summary_zh: GeoPAR 以投影窗口稀疏几何、稀疏边偏置注意力和缓存引导的冲突感知分配，处理大规模多智能体组合优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究将局部几何结构和互斥任务冲突显式纳入并行自回归求解，在异构车辆路径及开放式多仓取送问题上报告了零样本泛化和推理效率改进。
items.abstract_zh: 多智能体组合优化问题因其 NP-hard 性质而极具挑战性。近期的并行自回归神经求解器允许智能体同时决策，从而提高推理效率，但其在大规模实例上的表现常会下降。这主要归因于对局部几何结构的建模较弱，以及冲突任务选择仅在动作生成之后才被处理。为解决这些问题，我们提出 GeoPAR，一个面向可扩展多智能体组合优化的几何引导并行自回归强化学习框架。GeoPAR 整合三个关键组成部分：（1）投影窗口稀疏几何机制，通过多方向投影构建轻量的局部候选邻域；（2）稀疏边偏置注意力，将这些几何关系注入节点表征；（3）缓存引导的冲突感知分配，在解码过程中复用几何缓存，以抑制对互斥任务的重复选择。在异构车辆路径和开放式多仓取送问题上的实验表明，GeoPAR 改进了大规模零样本泛化，同时显著减少 rollout 步数并保持高效推理。
items.author_line: Wenjian Wu, Zesheng Jia, Jiaying Tang, Benyuan Yang, Jin Wang

items.title: MutMem-V2: Cryptographically Authorized Mutation in Persistent Agent Memory Portable Verification and Reproducible Evidence
items.abstract_or_text: MutMem V1 introduced retention-preserving, cryptographically authorized mutation for persistent agent memory but did not provide a complete portable verification contract or clean-install reproduction path. MutMem V2 closes that publication gap without introducing a second memory engine. It specifies exact canonical bytes, domain-separated object and bundle commitments, mandatory recall-evidence membership and ordering, external trust anchors, identity epochs, revocation, authorization, request receipts, ordered disclosure, and three mutation terminal types. The released protocol contains 18 versioned object schemas, 39 recall vectors, 15 mutation vectors, and 37 closed recall failure reasons. Independent Node and Python implementations agree on verdict and primary reason for all 72 structural and cryptographic terminals; a production-conformance corpus agrees on 42/42 cases across 28 required classes. A clean Node v26.8.1 installation reaches first-boot, restart, and scheduler readiness with no experimental memories. A separately scoped 120-unit Canary experiment supports only explicit-marker traversal. Every public table regenerates from a self-hashed aggregate, and an independent verifier reconstructs the statistics and claim boundaries. Historical V1 empirical results remain historical. MutMem V2 supports claims about portable integrity, authorization, traceability, conformance, and reproducibility under stated assumptions; it does not establish semantic truth, universal robustness, or independent replication.
items.summary_zh: MutMem-V2 为持久智能体记忆的加密授权修改给出可移植验证规范、测试向量和独立实现一致性结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其公开的模式、回忆与修改向量以及独立验证器，使授权、可追溯性和一致性主张可被复算；论文也明确不把这些结果扩展为语义真实性或普遍稳健性。
items.abstract_zh: MutMem V1 提出了可保留既有内容、经加密授权的持久智能体记忆修改，但没有给出完整的可移植验证约定或全新安装复现路径。MutMem V2 弥补了这一发表缺口，且未引入第二个记忆引擎。它规定了精确的规范字节、域分离的对象和包承诺、强制性的回忆证据成员关系和排序、外部信任来源、身份纪元、撤销、授权、请求回执、有序披露以及三类修改终止类型。发布的协议包含 18 个版本化对象模式、39 个回忆向量、15 个修改向量和 37 个封闭的回忆失败原因。独立的 Node 和 Python 实现对全部 72 个结构和加密终止情形的判定及首要原因均一致；一个生产一致性语料在 28 个必需类别的 42/42 个案例上也一致。全新 Node v26.8.1 安装可在没有实验性记忆的情况下达到首次启动、重启和调度器就绪状态。每张公开表均可由一个自哈希汇总重新生成，独立验证器能够重建统计数据及主张适用范围。历史 V1 实证结果仍仅属于历史记录。MutMem V2 在给定假设下支持关于可移植完整性、授权、可追溯性、一致性和可复现性的主张；它不能证明语义真实性、普遍稳健性或独立复现。

items.title: Reinforcement Learning Enhanced LLM Agents for Complex Vehicle Routing Problems
items.abstract_or_text: Vehicle Routing Problems (VRPs) are fundamental combinatorial optimization problems with widespread applications in various scenarios. The advanced optimization solvers can effectively solve such problems. However, modeling complex VRP variants for solvers often requires substantial domain expertise, which limits the accessibility of advanced optimization technologies. In this paper, we propose Reinforcement Learning Enhanced LLMAgents(RLEA), a multi-agent framework designed to automate the modeling of complex VRPs. RLEA introduces a lightweight neural Planner trained with Soft Q-learning to efficiently orchestrate the actions of LLM-based agents. In addition, we equip the system with an evolutionary memory module and retrieval-augmented generation, enabling the agent to leverage both accumulated experience and external solver knowledge during program generation and refinement for solving VRPs. We evaluated 48 distinct VRP variants across various solvers. The experimental results demonstrate that RLEA outperforms the previous state-of-the-ar method, achieving a 16.67% higher success rate while significantly reducing runtime errors. These results validate that integrating reinforcement learning with LLM-based reasoning is highly effective for automated optimization modeling. The appendix is available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19134435.
items.summary_zh: RLEA 使用 Soft Q-learning 训练轻量规划器来协调 LLM 智能体，并结合演化记忆和检索增强生成，自动完成复杂车辆路径问题的求解器建模。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 48 个不同 VRP 变体和多种求解器上的评测提供了明确任务及成功率指标；相对既有方法报告的成功率提升为 16.67%。
items.abstract_zh: 车辆路径问题（VRP）是具有广泛应用场景的基础组合优化问题。先进优化求解器可以有效求解此类问题。然而，为求解器建模复杂的 VRP 变体通常需要大量领域专业知识，这限制了先进优化技术的可及性。本文提出 Reinforcement Learning Enhanced LLMAgents（RLEA），一个旨在自动化复杂 VRP 建模的多智能体框架。RLEA 引入以 Soft Q-learning 训练的轻量神经 Planner，以高效协调基于 LLM 的智能体动作。此外，我们为系统配备演化记忆模块和检索增强生成，使智能体能够在解决 VRP 的程序生成与改进过程中利用累积经验和外部求解器知识。我们在多种求解器上评测了 48 个不同的 VRP 变体。实验结果表明，RLEA 优于此前的最先进方法，成功率高出 16.67%，同时显著减少运行时错误。这些结果验证了将强化学习与基于 LLM 的推理结合起来，对于自动化优化建模具有很高效力。附录见：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19134435。
items.author_line: Yi Chen, Zikang Yu, Jiahai Wang, Jinbiao Chen, Jianpeng Zhou, Zizhen Zhang

items.title: Trace as State: Reasoning Traces as Conditional States for Long-Context Transformers
items.abstract_or_text: Transformers process information causally, but long-context reasoning may depend on task state discovered only later. We formalize this mismatch through conditional state update tasks. For causal state update processors, providing the condition first can require exponentially less memory in the worst case than providing it last. Motivated by this principle, we introduce Trace as State. We use collected reasoning traces as a textual proxy for task state and place it before the long-context block on a fresh pass, allowing information derived previously to guide rereading. We conduct extensive experiments on Trace as State and Trace Append, a matched control that uses the same task state proxy but put it after the context. Across three models and three long-context datasets, Trace as State outperforms Trace Append in 26 of 27 reported combinations of model, task, and metric. On GraphWalks Parents, exact match lifts DeepSeek V4 Pro Preview from 29.2% on the initial pass and 43.0% with Trace Appendto 81.8% with Trace as State, and from 66.4% and 83.2% to 100.0% for GLM-5.2. These results show that placing traces before the context can improve long-context reasoning while retaining the causal transformer structure.
items.summary_zh: Trace as State 将已有推理轨迹作为任务状态的文本代理，并置于长上下文之前重新读取，以考察轨迹位置对长上下文推理的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文先给出条件状态更新处理器的最坏情形内存分析，再以位置匹配对照在三个模型、三个数据集上比较；26/27 组结果优于 Trace Append。
items.abstract_zh: Transformer 以因果方式处理信息，但长上下文推理可能依赖于仅在较后位置才发现的任务状态。我们通过条件状态更新任务将这种不匹配形式化。对于因果状态更新处理器，在最坏情形下，先提供条件所需的内存可以比后提供条件少指数倍。受此原理启发，我们提出 Trace as State。我们将收集到的推理轨迹用作任务状态的文本代理，并在一次新的处理过程中将其置于长上下文块之前，使先前推导的信息能够指导重新阅读。我们对 Trace as State 和 Trace Append 进行了广泛实验；后者是一个匹配对照，使用同一个任务状态代理，但将其置于语境之后。在三个模型和三个长上下文数据集上，Trace as State 在报告的 27 组模型、任务和指标组合中的 26 组优于 Trace Append。在 GraphWalks Parents 上，DeepSeek V4 Pro Preview 的精确匹配从初次处理的 29.2%、Trace Append 的 43.0% 提升至 Trace as State 的 81.8%；GLM-5.2 则从 66.4% 和 83.2% 提升至 100.0%。这些结果表明，在语境之前放置轨迹可以在保留因果 Transformer 结构的同时改进长上下文推理。

items.title: The Dynamics of Continuous Mixture Collapse in Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: LLMs latent-state reasoning methods replace discrete intermediate tokens with continuous states, such as weighted mixtures of token embeddings, to retain multiple possible reasoning directions rather than committing to one. Yet pretrained language models often fail to preserve these mixtures. We study why through a combination of theoretical analysis and controlled empirical investigations on a variety of models. We identify three independent, distinct sources of failure. First, transformer architectures already distort mixture geometry, and training substantially amplifies this effect. Moreover, the failure can occur even if the model transports mixtures perfectly linearly: the softmax readout and autoregressive feedback form a dynamical system that either amplifies small differences until one component of the mixture dominates or contracts different mixtures until they become indistinguishable. We verify this theoretical prediction empirically: the observed transition between contraction and amplification occurs near the theoretical threshold derived by our analysis, and pretrained-model rollouts lie predominantly on the amplifying side. Finally, we generalize to mixtures of many components and show that exact preservation generally requires context-dependent correction, whose required dimensionality can grow with the number of components.
items.summary_zh: 该工作通过理论分析和受控实验研究语言模型中连续混合状态为何会塌缩，并识别 Transformer、softmax 读出与自回归反馈造成的三类失效来源。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将连续潜在推理能否保留多条可能路径转化为可检验的动力学问题，并报告观测到的收缩—放大转换接近理论阈值。
items.abstract_zh: LLM 的潜在状态推理方法以连续状态替代离散中间词元，例如使用词元嵌入的加权混合，以保留多个可能的推理方向而不必选定其中一个。然而，预训练语言模型往往无法保留这些混合。我们通过理论分析与在多种模型上的受控实证研究相结合，探究其原因。我们识别出三个相互独立且不同的失效来源。第一，Transformer 架构本身已经会扭曲混合几何，训练会显著放大这一效应。而且，即便模型以完全线性的方式传输混合，失效仍可能发生：softmax 读出和自回归反馈构成一个动力系统，要么放大微小差异直到混合中的一个成分占据主导，要么压缩不同混合直到它们不可区分。我们以实证方式验证了这一理论预测：观测到的收缩与放大之间的转换发生在由分析推导出的理论阈值附近，并且预训练模型的 rollout 主要位于放大一侧。最后，我们将分析推广至许多成分的混合，并表明精确保留通常需要依赖语境的校正，其所需维数可随成分数量增长。

items.title: Belief-Calibrated Optimization: An Explicit World Model for Agentic Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: The performance of an LLM agent depends on the scaffold around a frozen model. A common way to improve that scaffold is to use a coding agent as an optimizer: it reads current scores and traces and iteratively edits the source, producing a new candidate each round. Each edit is chosen according to a belief about how the environment will respond: what went wrong, and which change should help. That belief is typically implicit. It lives in the coding agent's reasoning on the current call, or remains latent in its parameters, rather than as something written down. Later calls therefore see scores and traces, but they do not use that belief. We introduce Belief-Calibrated Optimization (BCO), a method that writes that belief down as a persistent in-context document and continually revises that document as new candidates are evaluated. The resulting document is a world model: the current account of how the environment responds to edits. Added to an otherwise standard loop, BCO reaches a higher train passrate than a matched control that lacks only the world model, on five benchmarks spanning memory QA, tool-use QA, code-as-action app agents, and terminal agents. The gap remains on every held-out split, which is not used to select the candidate. After a target-model swap, in which the frozen model is replaced and the scaffold is not, the selected BCO scaffold leads on the tasks we test, except where context-window overruns leave it unfinished. An offline ablation then asks whether that gap comes from what the world model says. A fresh predictor given the accumulated document forecasts how the environment will respond more accurately than predictors given either no document or a same-form copy whose content has been falsified. The comparison indicates that the document carries reusable information in its content, not only in its form.
items.summary_zh: Belief-Calibrated Optimization（BCO）将编码智能体对环境响应的假设写入并持续修订为显式世界模型，用于指导后续支撑框架优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 五项基准、留出划分、目标模型替换和内容伪造消融共同测试该文档是否携带可复用信息，避免将改进简单归因于文档形式。
items.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体的性能取决于围绕一个固定模型构建的支撑框架。改进该框架的一种常见方式是将编码智能体用作优化器：它读取当前分数和轨迹，迭代修改源代码，并在每一轮产生新候选。每次修改都依据一种关于环境将如何响应的信念：哪里出了问题，以及什么改动可能有帮助。这种信念通常是隐含的。它存在于编码智能体当前调用时的推理中，或潜藏在其参数中，而没有被写下来。因此，后续调用能够看到分数和轨迹，却不使用这种信念。我们提出 Belief-Calibrated Optimization（BCO），一种将该信念写入持久化上下文文档、并随着新候选被评估而持续修订该文档的方法。所得文档是一个世界模型：对环境如何响应修改的当前说明。在一个其他方面标准的循环中加入 BCO 后，在涵盖记忆问答、工具使用问答、以代码作为动作的应用智能体和终端智能体的五项基准上，其训练通过率高于仅缺少世界模型的匹配对照。该差距在每一个未用于选择候选的留出划分上都存在。在目标模型替换中，固定模型被替换而支撑框架保持不变，所选择的 BCO 支撑框架在所测试任务上领先，只有语境窗口超限使其未完成的情形例外。随后，一个离线消融检验该差距是否来自世界模型的内容。给定累积文档的全新预测器，比没有文档或获得同形式但内容被伪造副本的预测器，更准确地预测环境将如何响应。该比较表明，文档以其内容携带可复用信息，而非仅凭其形式。
items.author_line: Yuhan Chen, Zhihua Tian, Mahavir Dabas, Charith Peris, Rahul Gupta, Ming Jin, Feiyang Kang, Siyuan Zhang, Nan Wang, Ruoxi Jia

items.title: Agentic Empirical Asset Pricing: Methodological Foundations
items.abstract_or_text: Recent advances in LLM agents enable a new paradigm for asset pricing, which we call Agentic Empirical Asset Pricing (AEAP): systems that autonomously conduct the scientific discovery process itself. We define AEAP and identify its core building blocks. Existing evaluation practices backtest only the outputs (factors or trades), not the autonomous discovery system that produced them. We focus on factor discovery, contributing a reference architecture, a rigorous evaluation standard for discovered factors, and a method for out-of-sample backtesting the discovery system. As a concrete instance of that architecture, we evaluate SEADS against five re-implemented baselines on two US equity panels using this standard: no single metric ranks the systems consistently, motivating evaluation on multiple axes at once. A separate rolling re-execution then asks the complementary question of whether the discovery process itself, not one static output, is reliable. We also report negative findings and limitations that surface further evaluation pitfalls for future AEAP systems.
items.summary_zh: Agentic Empirical Asset Pricing（AEAP）提出将因子发现过程本身作为评测对象，并以参考架构、多指标标准和滚动重新执行检验智能体研究流程。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究避免只评估单个因子或交易输出，转而检查自动发现过程在样本外重复运行时是否可靠，并报告了负面结果与评测局限。
items.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体的近期进展使资产定价出现一种新范式，我们称之为 Agentic Empirical Asset Pricing（AEAP）：能够自主完成科学发现过程本身的系统。我们定义 AEAP 并识别其核心组成部分。现有评测实践只回测输出结果（因子或交易），而不评估产生这些输出的自主发现系统。我们聚焦因子发现，提出一个参考架构、一个用于所发现因子的严格评测标准，以及一种对发现系统进行样本外回测的方法。作为该架构的一个具体实例，我们依据这一标准，在两个美国股票面板上将 SEADS 与五个重新实现的基线进行评测：没有单一指标能始终对这些系统给出一致排序，因此需要同时在多个维度上评估。单独进行的滚动重新执行进一步提出一个互补问题：发现过程本身而非某个静态输出是否可靠。我们还报告了负面发现和局限，它们揭示了未来 AEAP 系统更多的评测陷阱。
items.author_line: Yingjian Pan, Xiaowei Ding, Kay Giesecke
